properties.name: A reason given after the fact says so, and is never read as a check of the system today
properties.source: The /why brainstorm's first counter-argument (memory is a reconstruction), 2026-09-23
properties.statement: A recorded change whose reason was given later from memory, or is unknown, says so on the record; it is never read as a reason written at the time, and never counted as evidence that the system was checked against reality today.
